title: Interactional Fairness in LLM Multi-Agent Systems: An Evaluation Framework
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and benchmarking 'Interactional Fairness' (Interpersonal and Informational fairness) in LLM-based multi-agent systems. It frames fairness as a behavioral property and communicative norm, aiming to align AI systems with ethical and socially desirable standards of respect, honesty, and transparency.
